title: Ghost Market
overview: Hidden away in a remote location on Oahu's North Shore is 'Ono Market, a plate lunch shop that serves lost spirits, stuck between life and death. The living have never set foot in this place - until a food-loving, would-be content creator named Kyle blunders in, eats a mixed plate for the dead, and accidentally turns himself into a half-ghost. To get back to normal, he'll have to deal with paranormal deliveries, long hours in a haunted kitchen, and scariest of all... his own family.

title: EK
overview: Save the world, or destroy it. EK, the youngest superhero the world never asked for, is accepted into the rising superhero unit with the goal of saving the world from a new threat called Evil D. The only problem is that he is neither good nor evil and works both ways. What will happen and will he succeed?

overview: Set in the Longlegs universe. Plot TBA.

title: Escape From Letterkenny
overview: A Metalhead makes a deal with God...  This film follows the intertwining meanderings of some typical Letterkenny residents over a few highly eventful days. Some are good, some are bad, some are morally vague. All are trapped in the same town. This film is about getting out. It's about breaking the shackles that hold you back by any means necessary, even if that means embracing utter chaos. It's about standing up to your outer demon. It's about friendship. It's about blossoming love. It's about dodgy-looking drugs. It will wreck your head. Or at the very least, it will make you question what kind of God you have.

title: The Marked Room
overview: A post-societal Texas, where the frozen thickets are roamed by Survivors, Scavengers, Thieves, and Killers. A grizzled crew venture into the Black Zone, an exceedingly dangerous area shrouded in mystery. Treasure calls from the depths of the zone; "Salvation" or "Doom".

title: The Nightingale

overview: A family of American tourists wander innocently into Taylor's hunting grounds. When the parents sacrifice themselves to save their children, the kids find themselves alone, lost and hunted in the vast Australian wilderness.

title: Street Fighter 8 (Finish Him)
overview: The final chapter. Balthasar turned all wimen on earth in to Merle and starts his conquest to rule the whole world. Nick and Luca the two only survivors of the deadly conflict angainst Balthasar, are trying to build a team that could stop the purple gigant from dominating the mordern world. Balthasar and the Boys are are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of Merle, Balthasar, the Boys and the future for even human beeing on earth.

title: Astonishers
overview: The reporters call them the 'Guardians of Tomorrow’,  the people call them the ‘ASTONISHERS’. The Man of Tomorrow, The Dark Knight, The Man Without Fear and your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man must confront their grief and stop the renewed Dark Lord of the Sith DARTH VADER and his group of Watchmen from reshaping Earth and its people to his will.

title: BORN SEXY YESTERDAY: Decoding the Enigma of Beauty
original_title: BORN SEXY YESTERDAY: Decoding the Enigma of Beauty
overview: The phrase "Born Sexy Yesterday" is derived from the 1950 film "Born Yesterday." However beneath this superficial portrayal of some women lies a more complex understanding , revealing deeper narratives that resonate with many.  October 1, 1985. The chilling emptiness in Michele Avila's eyes. Her murder, a savage ballet of teenage fury, ripped through the town, festering wounds exposing the venomous underbelly of a seemingly innocent friendship. Jealousy, a serpent coiled in the heart of adolescence, struck with the force of a viper, revealing the terrifying depths of envy's reach. These weren't just girls; they were predators.  Women are born with many layers, a mix between good and evil. Ironically of all the positive tropes that can validate the existence of women, why is it that "Born Sexy Yesterday" is a trope that resonates with our male counterparts the most?

title: The Grasp Dark Within
overview: A 19-year-old man is trapped between a dark force in his mind and a small positive energy fighting to save him. As both sides battle for control, his reality distorts, forcing him into a psychological struggle for survival.

title: Split-Vision
overview: The next film created by Krister Kahl.

title: Outer Focus

title: Aafreen Manzil

As hours pass, she is forced to face a truth she has long suppressed. Pushed to a reckoning, she finds the courage to take a step toward reclaiming her life.

title: Carver
overview: A hangout between two brothers experiences unexplainable and intrusive interruptions.

title: The Dreamy Sketcher
overview: In a quiet corner of Bellevue Square sits a dreamy sketcher, wondering at the beauty of what is today...

title: Nemesis
overview: 20 years after meeting his identical twin with no explanation, a man finds that his brother is not all he seems.

title: The Thomas Crown Affair
overview: A debonair, adventuresome man believes he has pulled off the perfect multi-million dollar heist, only to match wits with an insurance investigator who will do anything to get her man.

title: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera
original_title: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera
overview: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera is a romantic musical story about a dream boy who always wishes to become a film hero. One day, while walking with his sister near Gokarna Shaheed Smarak Park in Kathmandu, he sees a film song being shot. Excited by the cameras, lights, music, and dancers, he asks his sister to go closer. Among the dancers, he notices a beautiful girl whose graceful dance immediately captures his heart. He begins to imagine himself as the hero of the song, dancing and romancing with her. In his dream, they share joyful and romantic moments filled with love, laughter, and chemistry. He expresses his feelings and even proposes marriage, dreaming of spending their lives together. At the end of the song, the girl whispers in his ear, “Let’s go together.” Suddenly, the director says, “Okay, cut!” and the dream boy returns to reality. His sister takes him home, leaving him with a beautiful dream of love and his wish to become a film hero.

title: Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down
original_title: Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down
overview: "Don't Let The Bastards Grind You Down" is a documentary film about British social policy. The focus is on the political struggle against neoliberal austerity policies, which have their origins in the hated Thatcher government.  The film features the former socialist MP Dave Nellist, who is now the national chair of the Trade Unionist & Socialist Coalition and Hannah Sell, the general secretary of the Socialist Party. The film features a local election campaign in the miners' town of Nuneaton, students campaigning against an increase in tuition fees and refuse workers from Birmingham striking against massive cuts to their wages.

title: Black Hollow
overview: Set in the rural Midwest during the 1970s, Black Hollow follows Jessica, an innocent young girl sheltered by small-town faith and her worldly friend Helen, whose rebellious streak leads them both into danger. When the two sneak out one foggy night, they wander to a forgotten churchyard, an isolated place where sacred ground conceals something unholy. As darkness descends, Jessica's search for belonging turns to horror, forcing her to confront the evil that thrives beneath the surface of the American heartland.

title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
original_title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
overview: Mr. Lockwood arrives at the remote and storm-battered Wuthering Heights, unaware that Catherine's vengeful ghost walks its halls. Her obsessed lover, Heathcliff, feeds her bloodlust with human sacrifice, hoping to give her soul a new body to inhabit. As Lockwood grows sick and delusional, he is drawn deeper into their deadly, undying love, and must escape before he becomes their next victim.

title: new folk song
overview: A journey poem of freedom, as Toronto inhabitants harness public space for their own purposes.

title: Frank and Percy
overview: During their dog walks on Hampstead Heath, two older gentlemen find their conversations about everyday aches and weather growing into an unexpected connection.

title: Still Here
overview: Adrift between memories and an endless void, a young man searches for a way back to something he thought he had lost.

title: Outgrowth
overview: A young girl forms an unlikely bond with the disembodied hand beneath her bed.

title: I Don’t Love You Anymore
overview: In a Niagara Falls motel, an unremarkable couple attempts a romantic getaway. But as the days go by, the trip threatens to turn into a cold shower. I Don’t Love You Anymore is a humorous exploration of the red flags we choose to ignore to keep a relationship alive.

title: The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: Platypus
overview: Kimberly, a young schoolgirl in a small town, secretly dreams of the masked killer Platypus terrorizing the area. But nobody believes her, and the dreams are becoming more vivid, more violent, and ever closer to home.

title: Billy Gauthier: Carving the Future
overview: With each stroke of his blade, acclaimed Inuk carver Billy Gauthier instills his art with his passion for his home, Labrador. His carvings are sought after across the globe for their flowing intricate details and profound messages rooted in Inuit culture and connections to the natural world. Billy Gauthier: Carving the Future is an intimate look at the master sculptor’s meticulous process and the inspiration behind one of the most ambitious creations of his career: the carving of a monumental whale skull.

title: The World Is A Wedding
overview: A teenager joins his grandmother at a mahjong game, where he encounters a mysterious woman threatening to unravel secrets from their family's past.

title: Gorilla, Guerrilla
overview: Peru, 1968. Deep in the jungle, a ragtag film crew is stranded without money, morale, or meaning. Three months behind schedule, they must survive a collapsing production and their dangerously paranoid director.

title: Yuja
overview: Daredevil. Rebel. Powerhouse. At 39, Yuja Wang stands among the most electrifying musicians of our time and she is falling out of love with the music. In Yuja, acclaimed filmmaker Lorna Tucker crafts an immersive portrait of an artist in flux. With unprecedented access, the film weaves together performance, memory, and reconstruction to explore the forces that shape Yuja, and the woman she is still becoming.

title: The Julia Set
overview: Julia, a gifted mathematician, navigates the cutthroat world of academia. Pascal, a teaching assistant, recruits her to join an exclusive training program for the prestigious and notoriously difficult Putnam mathematics competition.

title: Bad Parenting
overview: Two young brothers are left alone in a car while their dad paddleboards out at sea. When a mischievous local boy climbs into the backseat, an ordinary beach day takes a dangerous turn.

title: The Echo Chamber
overview: Leo and Ava chase each other—coming close, drifting apart, and searching for their way back. They cannot let go, nor break free. Through the rooms, Ava’s voice echoes across time, carrying to the surface what endures—and what can no longer be held back.

title: The Haunted Hunter
overview: A hunter is terrorised by a temporarily unseen entity.

title: Songs Of The Vineyard: You Are Here
original_title: Songs Of The Vineyard: You Are Here
overview: An animated feature film with a soundtrack made from recycled junk shop tapes.

title: Cryface
overview: On her birthday, a lonely, depressed girl gets stalked by an entity that tries to cheer her up.

title: A Few Moments of Happiness
overview: A young woman watches the war in Lebanon through her phone, from her bed in Paris. Through digital images, family voices, and silences, the film explores the dissociation of a generation condemned to witness the destruction of the world from afar. An intimate essay on exile, screens, and the exhaustion of being a witness.

title: Route 66: The Main Street of America
original_title: Route 66: The Main Street of America
overview: Route 66: The Main Street of America is a centennial celebration of this legendary highway. It’s a powerfully moving feature-length documentary that travels the route, sharing unforgettable stories along the way. From unexpected roadside attractions to revitalized main streets, each encounter reveals communities finding new life and purpose—making new history—proving the most meaningful journeys often unfold on the road less traveled.

title: Echoes of The Forks of Cypress
original_title: Echoes of The Forks of Cypress
overview: Echoes of Forks of Cypress explores the lives of the enslaved and enslavers at the Forks of Cypress plantation in Florence, AL. The documentary highlights their struggles, resilience, and the plantation’s historical significance. It then shifts to the present, where descendants from both sides come together to confront and heal from their shared past.

title: 32 Frames: A 9/11 Mystery
overview: A journalist receives 32 new photos of 9/11 from a camera found in the rubble of the World Trade Center — and uses clues in each frame to ID the photographer.

title: Wildcards
overview: A jury deliberating the case of Theodore Sterling, a privileged young man accused of sexual assault of a 20-something African-American woman. The prosecution is led by Assistant State Attorney James Jones, an overworked yet determined prosecutor, who faces off against Greg Sims, a veteran defense attorney with an unbroken 25-year winning streak.

title: Fool's Gold
overview: After a failed robbery, three friends face the consequences of their actions.
A 90 minute static shot of a clock as it counts down the time until 1am, the time of the filmmaker’s birth.

title: Tottenham ‘Til I Die
overview: A film by Alfie Whiteman

title: Striking Matches
overview: Mellow is drifting through life without a purpose still trying to connect with the world around her while something darker is lurking beneath the surface.

title: A Fistful of Love
overview: Things go downhill on the set of a documentary about disability when an intern suspects the director may be manipulating his subject.

title: Restless in the Dust
overview: After leaving to chase a life bigger than the one he was given, Jim returns home, but past mistakes come back to haunt him. Now he will have to decide how far he's willing to go to protect everyone he loves.

title: Good Omens - The Musical
overview: There is a hint of Armageddon in the air.  According to the least-selling book of 1655 —The Nice and Accurate Prophecies of Agnes Nutter, Witch — the world will come to an end on a Saturday  Next Saturday in fact.  The Armies of Good and Evil are massing, the Four Horsemen have been unleashed. Atlantis is rising, frogs are falling, tempers are flaring, and everything appears to be going to Divine Plan.  Except that a fastidious Angel and a fast-living Demon, who have enjoyed a rather decadent lifestyle on earth for six millennia, are not particularly looking forward to the coming Rapture. They just have to find a way to indefinitely postpone Armageddon.  There’s only one problem: they’ve misplaced the Anti-Christ.

title: Mother
overview: Mother is an emotional Tamil family drama that explores the profound dynamics, deep love, and selfless sacrifices inherent in motherhood. Following a limited theatrical release through digital cinema networks like SDC, this intimate, small-scale production captures a moving and relatable narrative about core familial bonds.

title: You A Foe
overview: A man tries to eliminate his extraterrestrial best friend's other extraterrestrial friend.

title: I Never Wanted to be Horny
original_title: I Never Wanted to be Horny

title: Honor Among Thieves
overview: In early 1970, an amateur film crew shot a no-budget heist movie in Knoxville, TN. Throughout the shoot, cast members gathered in an abandoned quarry, a local bar, and a defunct bank building to get their vision on film. The cinematographer perched on top of a car to film a highway chase, and the whole company trekked into the foothills for a climactic foot pursuit and brawl. The resulting film, HONOR AMONG THIEVES, was never seen widely and never made a dime--but it did get its writer-director out of a term paper.

title: The Imp
overview: A short film by the makers of Honor Among Thieves.

title: The Bookstore That Never Sleeps
overview: An intimate, character-driven documentary about Christopher Webb, the enigmatic owner of a small independent bookstore in Lunenburg, Nova Scotia. Unlike other local shops, the store opens only after sundown, offering a quietly quirky haven for night owls, wanderers, and those drawn to the light. A former sailor, Chris carries the emotional echoes of his time at sea, shaped by sleepless nights and the lingering shadows of life on the water.

title: Shiawase wa Tabete Nete Mate: Soshun no Yojo Hen
original_title: しあわせは食べて寝て待て～早春の養生編～
overview: Mugimaki Satoko, who has developed an illness she will have to live with for the rest of her life, commutes from an apartment complex where the rent is 50,000 yen to her part-time job four days a week. Having given up on moving to the countryside, she has been feeling somewhat depressed.  One winter day, Tsukasa, who is staying next door, invites her to go for an early-morning walk, but she turns him down. Satoko, who feels self-conscious because everything requires physical strength, is hesitant and says, "Someone like me..." even as her landlady, Suzu, and neighbor Koma get excited talking about romance. Suzu then invites Satoko to her home.  Amid her usual daily life with her coworkers and friends from the apartment complex, surrounded by medicinal cuisine, Satoko gradually finds small moments of happiness. This is a special episode about those ordinary yet quietly wonderful days.

title: Larpboxray's Larping Party
overview: A Compilation of Regal, Fox, Sam, and Chez's presentations at Fox's birthday presentation.

title: Brain Stew
overview: A lonely man with a 9-5 tries to start a band in the midst of a zombie apocalypse.

overview: In a basement-turned boy cave, a band rehearsal spirals into chaos as creative tensions and personal drama push four teenage musicians to the brink.

title: Bed Rot
overview: After a painful breakup, a young man retreats into his bed, convinced that staying there will help him. But as the days pass, getting out of bed becomes harder and eventually... impossible.

original_title: Once a Princess, Always a Princess

title: Ferar Opekkhay

Over time, they learn that true beauty is not about appearance, but about compassion, trust, and unconditional love.

title: Sacred Creatures

Three estranged siblings reunite in Italy years after the middle sister had a psychotic episode she believed to have been a spiritual awakening. As her behaviour grows increasingly strange, tensions between the siblings rise while a group of local acolytes find her increasingly compelling.

overview: Gus, JJB and Ferdi find a bag with more than 5,000 €, they debate about who can take the money

title: In the Light of Day
overview: A lesbian woman plans to escape her small town with her married lover, but when her lover refuses to leave, she must make a choice.

title: Blue Sadness
overview: A janitor has a routine cleanup in a building. As he sweeps through each floor, he notices the third floor is not like the rest. A sinister figure lurks beyond the blue darkness.

title: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration
original_title: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration
overview: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration at Disneyland Resort brings together the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars ever assembled, celebrating the iconic stories across animation, live-action, stage, and music. This one-of-a-kind concert will transform the night skies with dazzling lights, sweeping projections, and sky-high fountains creating a truly immersive world where the music, magic, and legacy of Disney Princesses shine like never before.

title: Home Sweet Home
overview: Just a nice, relaxing day at home. Nothing more. So stop asking.

title: Electric Mushrooms
overview: As the Cheshire Cat once said: Imagination is the only weapon in the war against reality. This is Electric Mushrooms...

title: Gemini, The Apple Of My Eye!
original_title: Gemini, The Apple Of My Eye!
overview: Returning to his childhood home, Kerry and his partner Gina become trapped in a surreal reality that forces long-buried family memories to resurface.

overview: Gus, Jo and Ferdi try to find the murderer who killed their friend.

overview: Jane visits an old friend.

overview: An archaeologist, a professor, a navigator, and a translator are all that are left from the original research team. After releasing something they never meant to, this group is hiding out, waiting to be hunted down by the very thing they released upon the world.

title: Ambience
overview: a short film about ambience and nature

title: Me & My TV
overview: On her daily routine, Julie, is met with a TV that arrives at her doorstep, left by a mysterious figure. She tries to resume her day as normal but the TV keeps following her, constantly reminding her of her late husband, Terri.

title: Perception
overview: A troubled young man is pushed to his limits as he tries to find the man responsible for his girlfriend's recent disappearance. In his mission for answers, he speaks with his therapist who guides him to a horrifying discovery which changes his perception forever.

title: DELELU
overview: It's about a student who goes in delusion while studying..

title: Unreleased
overview: UNRELEASED takes you inside the Vile Parle Cypher, a grassroots rap community in Mumbai founded by 20-year-old Kuldeep. Here, milk delivery boys, security guards, chefs, students and young rappers come together to turn their everyday struggles, dreams and identities into music. Away from the spotlight of India's mainstream hip-hop scene, they build their own space, find their voice and refuse to be unheard.

title: Despicable Nights in Heaven
overview: When a married man's clandestine affair erupts into a grotesque confrontation in his apartment parking lot, his carefully constructed life begins to unravel in ways he never imagined. As he and his wife recount the same night through competing video-call confessions, a simple scandal transforms into a brutally funny and painfully intimate dissection of their marriage. Each revelation exposes not just betrayal, but the lies people tell themselves to preserve their identities, justify their choices, and survive intimacy. Blending biting humour with emotional precision, the film is a dark comedy about guilt, narcissism, and the uncomfortable truth that bringing everything into the open does not necessarily set anyone free.

title: Texas Fold-em
overview: An infamous criminal gambles with his life over a game of cards with a sheriff.

title: Phantasmagoria: A Fever Dream Story
overview: Felix is living a peaceful life in his city, until him and a unorthodox detective are brought together through different worlds, to face a threat more adventurous than he could handle.

title: The Boy Who Lost His Family: A Claymation Fable
original_title: The Boy Who Lost His Family: A Claymation Fable
overview: A family tries to escape a cult, but their journey through the woods proves far more treacherous than they ever imagined

title: Solace
overview: Stricken with grief after the loss of a loved one, a woman must confront her past in order to find peace.

title: Blink
overview: Finn lives a normal life until one day he meets a mysterious stranger who turns his life upside down. As he begins blacking out and losing memory of what he does during the day, he slowly uncovers a conspiracy that he is at the centre of.

title: Elijah Peel
overview: A stadium-filling rock star, Elijah Peel is at the top of the world … until his addiction leads to a heart attack that could cost him everything. During his recovery, Elijah encounters a remarkable young girl whose unwavering faith, radiant spirit, and wisdom beyond her years begin to break through the walls he has built around his heart. Her extraordinary hope and their unexpected bond inspire Elijah to begin a powerful journey toward healing, reconciliation, and faith.

title: Laghdaithe le hAois
overview: A Violent Implosion Of Physical And Exhaustive Energy. An Intensified Requiem For Unsustainable Nights. All That I Hold In My Heart, Diminished With Age, Burning Softly Away Within The Smothered Hours Of Abstraction And Certainty.

title: Frutiger Aero: New Horizons
overview: Profile and Eco make it to the Real World. With the help of new friends, they try to find their way back to the Frutiger Aero World.

title: 100 Days in One
overview: An unknown mysterious teenager lives his normal mundane life when all of a sudden, he finds himself stuck on the same day - Wednesday, October 29th.  The protagonist must do anything he can to escape this loop or be trapped forever...

title: American Humor
overview: When Bob is entrusted by his dad to be the man of the house for a few hours, he and his friend David must find ways to entertain themselves.

title: Reverie
overview: Awakened by a sudden wind, a dancer moves through fragments of memory, each encounter stirring a new expression in a meditative space where movement becomes memory’s voice.

title: Boundless: The Man Who Became Human
original_title: Boundless: The Man Who Became Human
overview: Ben Greenfield taught millions how to master the body. This is the story of everything that mastery could not reach. What remains when a man can no longer outrun himself?

title: Pinche Nerdo
overview: An aspiring comic book artist from Tijuana crosses the border and suits up in cosplay to promote his work in the chaotic crowds of Comic-Con, where an unexpected encounter with an influential attendee forces him to make a choice about his dream.

title: The Summer Heat
overview: A dual snapshot of Irish summer; the favourable and the unavoidable.

title: Fuga
overview: Life has not been fulfilling to Mari.

title: Come to Brasil
overview: Look in the comment section of any celebrity and you'll see one comment more than any other: “Come to Brasil.” In the west, the phrase is brushed off as a meme, but for Brazilian fans, it's a rallying cry, a plea that unites fandoms in a country that even the biggest stars pass over on their so-called "world" tours. Through the eyes of four Rio de Janeiro pop music superfans, the most popular comment on the internet is explored as a vessel to highlight the uniting forces of music and the resilience of music lovers.

title: That We May See
overview: An intimate documentary on the lives and artistic journeys of Renato Habulan, Egai Fernandez, Pablo Baens-Santos, Jess Abrera, and Antipas Delotavo - pioneers of the Philippine Social Realist movement. Centered on the founding of KAISAHAN in 1976, the film examines how the realities of Martial Law under the Marcos dictatorship shaped a generation of artists committed to social engagement through their work. It also highlights the crucial role of CAYA (Center for the Advancement of Young Artists) in nurturing the movement's early development. Through personal reflections and historical and contemporary perspectives, the documentary traces the artists' shared ideals and divergent paths, revealing the challenges, convictions, and creative resilience that affirm their enduring vision of art as a force that shapes Filipino identity—as witness, critic, and visionary. Created in part through a grant of the National Commission on Culture and the Arts.

title: Mones
overview: Cici, a trans woman, confronts her gender dysphoria at her younger brother Teddy’s fraternity during a historic Pride party/drag show she put together with her best friends. As the drag performers, frat boys, and queers mingle, Cici has a romantic encounter with a familiar young man that leads to her overcoming her mental hurdles around being a woman. Ultimately, she learns the universal truth of womanhood… sometimes your titties just hurt! A high energy comedy that explores questions of identity.

title: Secondhand Embarrassment
overview: When two young shoppers spot a vintage sweater at a thrift store a high stakes battle ensues.

title: Sinking Road
overview: Dotty Duette gets pushed into the waters to drown by an unknown assailant, where she is then stuck on a magical golden road which drags her down to the underwater "Sinking Road Village". Once there, she meets the embodiments of the Buddhist precepts, some welcoming her and making her feel right at home until the road comes back down for her, and some, like the infamous 1st precept, being out for her blood.

title: I want you tenderness
overview: Experimental dance movie of the play "Je te veux de la tendresse" by Bastian A. Miranda

title: Valley of the Horntak
overview: During their search in the woods for a missing boy, an estranged father and son encounter a sinister cult who worship mind and flesh altering creatures.

title: Rabani
overview: “Rabani” – is a film about Ukrainian refugee with Sudanese roots, who is caught between memory and a relentless media stream that constructs a parallel life inside his mind. As he moves through Berlin, this mediated reality begins to distort his perception, until he can no longer distinguish which emotions are his own and which are imposed.

title: Someone's Daughter
overview: A criminal defence lawyer, Sam, (Pascale Bussières, Ma Vie en cinémascope, When Night is Falling), finds herself kidnapped and abandoned on a remote island along with former client Paul (François Arnaud, Heated Rivalry, Fucktoys, The Borgias), who she previously cleared of sexual assault charges. As they make their way through the unrelenting Canadian wilderness, Paul’s behaviour forces Sam to question the man she once defended. As doubt gives way to fear, she finds herself facing a choice no lawyer should ever have to make.

title: People Magazine Investigates: The Cult of the Soulful Journey
original_title: People Magazine Investigates: The Cult of the Soulful Journey
overview: Details how self-help guru Soulaire Allerai manipulated followers into financial and mental dependency through isolation and forced communal living. Former members describe the organization's promises of enlightenment masking a reality of strict control and abuse.

title: The Hunted
overview: Three deadly stories of pursuit collide in this horror-thriller anthology: a concussed runner and her dog are stalked in the wilderness, a serial killer targets an abusive man, and bank robbers turn on one another over a priceless score.

title: Glorious Disaster
overview: Documentary on Laurel & Hardy by David Cairns and Fiona Watson

title: Snowbound for the Holidays
overview: Hotel manager Cassidy Evergreen evaluates a cozy ski lodge, but Christmas magic—and its charming owner, Trey Sanderson—turn a simple assignment into a heartfelt choice between duty and love.

title: The Complete Story of Pep Guardiola's Manchester City
original_title: The Complete Story of Pep Guardiola's Manchester City
overview: Ten seasons, 20 trophies, fantastic goals, drama, emotion and everything else in-between, sit back and enjoy the journey all over again.

title: It Hunts
overview: An aimless nightcrawler races to unravel the mystery of the supernatural entity hunting him.

title: Orson Welles in Salt Lake City
original_title: Orson Welles in Salt Lake City
overview: The canceling of a test screening drags a young and paranoid Orson Welles into a unique nightmare on the streets of Salt Lake City.

title: The Man in the Second Story Window
original_title: The Man in the Second Story Window
overview: A Man sits at a desk, typing. Another Man sits across from him in a chair, sleeping. Outside, beneath them, reality plays out, as it has forever. Today, however, that changes.

title: A Darker Place: Cases from the DCA
original_title: A Darker Place: Cases from the DCA
overview: A team of D.C.A. Bio-Enforcers falls prey to a rogue anomaly, trapped in a nightmarish dimension where reality bends to the creature's will.

title: Lady Moonlight, Come Back
overview: After falling in love while in a dream, a girl has to make the decision on whether to stay and carry out a fake life, or live in reality without her lover.

title: Cuatro condenados a vivir se han escapado
original_title: Cuatro condenados a vivir se han escapado
overview: On Saturday night, four civilians were arrested for committing various minor crimes. Blitz Nova was arrested for assaulting a minor with a toy laser gun outside a high school. Desmond Benjamin was arrested for interfering with a police operation during a robbery because of "The Portuguese Homeland." John DeLuque was arrested for illegally selling the highly anticipated anime film "Pascual Does Not Dream About Foxy Girl Senpai" before its official release. Pau Cobos was arrested for illegally selling vapes.  Despite their different offenses, they all shared the same sentence: three days in the local police station's holding cells. But waiting was never an option for them. Together, they took the initiative to escape the facility.  The rest is history.

title: Ex Nihilo
overview: After a nuclear attack on the country, a lone wanderer explores the surroundings of a contaminated town, haunted by an unknown watcher. As the wanderer confronts the stranger, reality begins to distort under the influence of her psychological descent.

title: Hindsight
overview: A lone space explorer who investigates a distress signal on an uncharted planet, only to become stranded as strange events begin to unfold around him. As isolation takes its toll, he uncovers a mystery that challenges his understanding of reality itself.

title: The Lady in Red
overview: While getting ready to go on a date with her boyfriend, Linda realizes that there is something wrong with her reality.

title: Summertime Sadness
overview: A woman's quarter life crisis is exacerbated by the sweltering summer heat.

overview: A concert film that looks at the Montreal-born Brooklyn-based Gen-Z band making Guitar Music profitable again, Airy Foist taking the stage for the first time in Denver Colorado.

title: Promised

title: Communication
overview: When a mysterious boy finds himself trapped in a claustrophobic room, with the only form of communication being a broken landline. He goes on to figure out that the only way to get out is to talk to the person who trapped him there.

title: late quietus
overview: the woods are wordless, the eye is magic. night becomes spiral dancers

title: EROS
overview: Beatriz is trapped in a vicious cycle where she doesn’t feel seen. All of that changes once she meets Sofia.

title: SUICIDELAND

title: A Crime Story
overview: A group of misfits employed at a rundown motel stumble upon a drug trafficking operation orchestrated by a powerful crime syndicate, thrusting them into a perilous situation.

title: Peppa the Great
overview: A hustling entertainer puts her past behind her and will do anything to make it in New York City.

title: The Reality Experiment

title: Paul Simon: The Quiet Celebration Concert
original_title: Paul Simon: The Quiet Celebration Concert

title: Eclogues
overview: Landscapes are permeable, impermanent. They are hallucinations of literature, manifestations of human manipulation. Like the pixel, they are degraded, rearranged, forgotten. “Eclogues” is an expression of landscape in the purest principles of digital image-making: duration, practicality, limitation. Shot in 2020 in Strafford, Vermont.

title: Watched

title: Ashamed
